en.activity: Hilton Worldwide Holdings Inc., a hospitality company, engages in managing, franchising, and leasing hotels and resorts. It operates in two segments, Management and Franchise, and Ownership.
en.products: The company engages in the hotel management and licensing of its brand names, trademarks, and service marks.
